results.classificationRationale: The measured Panda target renders and its boundary graph is balanced; no A–G failure cause is present at this control.

classificationEvidence.authoredCloseCausalityEvidenceLimit: Exact direct Animate HalfEdge mapping is absent. Where a route through the same closed contour exists, it is multi-HalfEdge and does not establish equivalence to the source close marker. Removing generated close segments does not close the Panda graph. No successful close-marker control is present in the frozen corpus.
classificationEvidence.fillSideEvidenceLimit: Endpoint direction observations are not causal proof; the same opposite-direction convention also occurs in the successful controls.
classificationEvidence.edgeRunEvidenceLimit: Whole-Shape and target-fill subsegment counts match; the current receipt does not prove a source-identified duplicate or drop.
classificationEvidence.stitcherEvidenceLimit: The measured source-derived target boundary graph is itself open, so the evidence does not isolate a stitcher-only rejection of a proven closed graph.
classificationEvidence.animateDerivedTopologyEvidenceLimit: Closed Animate contours and unmatched interior edges are observed, but the successful #737 control also has 20 unmatched Animate interior edges; extra edges alone do not prove cause.

results.repairContract: No failure repair contract applies to this successful control.
confidenceLimits: Animate executable Authenticode status is captured in animateHost below; HashMismatch means this run does not prove an unmodified Adobe-signed binary.
The selected target-fill boundary has a per-segment exact-endpoint map. Non-target-fill draws do not have an Animate crosswalk in this receipt.
results.recommendedNextAction: Keep as a successful control. Do not treat unmatched extra Animate interior edges alone as proof of a Panda failure.
results.firstDivergence: No failure divergence observed: Panda renders the selected fill boundary. Any extra Animate interior edges are recorded as differences and do not imply a Panda failure.

degreeImpactOfRemovingGeneratedCloseSegm.conclusion: Removing the authored-close interpretation balances the observed boundary graph.

cubicComparison.proof: Raw XFL target FillStyle subsegment counts report zero cubic segments, and every Panda target-boundary command was inspected and none has type C. Whole-Shape non-target-fill cubic draws are outside this target-boundary comparison.

source.animatePathMappingRule: XFL path resolves to Animate DOM Shape after the terminal XFL child index 0; all observed matrix coefficients match.

summary.rawMidEdgeStyleChangeCountNote: Each source Edge record carries one fillStyle0/fillStyle1/strokeStyle tuple. No mid-edge fill-side directive was identified; S tokens are counted separately as selection markers by the production decoder.

rawXfl.segmentMapCoverageNote: Full decoded draw-subsegment totals are compared to Raw XFL totals. Per-segment links are retained for Panda source-side and target-fill boundary mappings; non-boundary decoded draws do not have a separate segment crosswalk in the source receipt.

animate.fillSignatureRule: Exact Animate solid fill color equals Raw XFL selected SolidColor.
